title: TEKMOVELA AcceptanceCriterion v1alpha1
description: An externally sourced AcceptanceCriterion reference with a digest and a testability assertion. TEKMOVELA records the immutable reference and digest; it does not own the source requirements lifecycle.

id.description: Dotted hierarchical identifier matching AxisRobo reference naming.

source_ref.description: Reference to the authoritative criterion in the IRIS/external requirements system.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the source criterion content as recorded by TEKMOVELA.

goal_ref.description: Optional goal or intent reference this criterion serves.

testable.description: Testability assertion. A non-testable criterion is a Requirement Gate blocker.

specification_maturity.description: IRIS NLR -> SIS -> AEI maturity as recorded, not rewritten, by TEKMOVELA.
